sources.entry: Wordpress | Run WordPress, MariaDB and phpMyAdmin in Docker

summary.one_liner: A Makefile- and docker-compose-based setup that runs WordPress, MariaDB and optional phpMyAdmin as Docker containers.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes running WP (WordPress), MariaDB and an optional phpMyAdmin as Docker containers, configured through a Makefile, a .env file and docker-compose.yml. Make targets cover install, purge, backup, restore, logs and container tests, such as "make purge install" for a fresh install or "make backup test" for a backup followed by tests. Optional hooks run cmd_extras.sh inside the WordPress container after installation and install_extras.sh outside it. During suspend, backup and restore operations it can start temporary static web containers. It also ships a wp binary with shell completion, bash aliases and some PHP ini setup. Alternative docker-compose examples are included, and memory limits are set via YAML anchors.
use_cases: self-host a WordPress blog or website in Docker
run WordPress with MariaDB and phpMyAdmin together
back up and restore a WordPress installation
set up a fresh WordPress install with make commands
serve a static fallback page during WordPress maintenance
notable: Entire deployment driven by Makefile, .env and docker-compose.yml only
Temporary static web container served during suspend, backup and restore
Optional cmd_extras.sh and install_extras.sh hooks for extra modules or daemons
Bundled wp binary with shell completion and bash aliases
caveats: README does not state a license
Run-time requirements beyond Docker and Make are not detailed in the README
Demo link is listed but left blank in the README
